syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. They help scientists learn about the brain. Researchers can control and study mice easily. In the past, scientists often used male mice in experiments. They chose male mice because they were worried. They thought that female hormones could change behavior. This could affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. They help scientists learn about the brain. Researchers can control and study mice easily. In the past, scientists often used male mice in tests. They chose male mice because they were worried. They thought that female hormones could change how mice act. This could change the results of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important in studying the brain. They help scientists understand how the brain works. Researchers can easily control and observe mice in their experiments. In the past, scientists often picked male mice for their tests. They chose male mice because they had concerns. They believed that female hormones, which change in a regular cycle, could affect how the mice behave. Because of this, the results of the tests might not be reliable.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Easy English. Use clear, descriptive and explanatory language. You can freely use the editing opertaions of adding, deleting and paraphrasing words, phrases and sentences.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying the brain. They help scientists understand how the brain works. Researchers can easily control and watch mice in their experiments. In the past, scientists often used male mice for their tests. They chose male mice because they were worried. They thought that female hormones, which change regularly, could affect how the mice act. This might make the test results unreliable.
